lines.3: She's sleeping in one heck of a position again today.
lines.6: 「She even looks stupid in her sleep...」
lines.7: This family has two children. One is a brilliant older brother currently studying in graduate school.
lines.9: And the other is this idiot talking in her sleep.
lines.11: She turned out to be such a disappointment that her parents call her "the dud" and have already given up on her. Poor girl.
lines.12: Then again, with her brother doing so well, they told her she might as well live however she wants. In a way, I'm almost jealous.
lines.13: 「Now, she won't wake up the normal way, so the question is how to do it...」
